packageUsageOverrides.reason: These optional platform packages remain visible in package-lock.json for reproducible source installs, but Canvas does not redistribute their prebuilt native/WASM payloads in the Next.js server, Docker or Electron artifacts. Docker builds both shipped sharp versions locally against the separately inventoried shared libvips and remove every @img/sharp-* directory before the runtime inventory and linkage tests run. A source user who opts into an upstream prebuilt package downloads it from npm rather than from a Canvas release artifact.
Sentry CLI is a source-map/build tool and is excluded from the production runtime payload.

additionalComponents.name: node-docker-base
additionalComponents.reviewNotes: This is an aggregate container position rather than one license grant. The Dockerfile pins the resolved multi-architecture image index digest, all Canvas apt operations use an immutable Debian snapshot, Python wheels and PGDG binaries are version/hash locked, and schema-4 runtime inventories map every installed Debian binary to its exact source package while retaining packaged license/copyright hashes. Tagged release CI verifies amd64 and arm64 evidence before publishing the manifest. The component-level terms remain authoritative under /usr/share/doc and in the release evidence; this aggregate intentionally has no fabricated single license text.
